reviewed.against: the technique record o-uchi-gaeshi, whose page carries the demonstration

about.en: As your partner reaps from the inside, lifting the attacked leg and sweeping their reaping leg out with it is the major inner counter, the named answer.

en: Their right leg hooks deep inside your left and starts to reap it away.
Step your left leg backwards out of the hook, keeping your hips square and your weight over that foot.
Their attacking leg is now committed and their standing leg is carrying everything.
Bring your right leg round behind that standing leg.
Reap it forwards while both hands drive their chest backwards.
They land on their back where they stood. Keep the sleeve and lower them under control.

receiving.en: You are attacking, and the leg you reached for steps out behind you, so your hook closes on nothing and your weight settles onto the standing leg. That is the leg they take. The fall is straight back and there is no time to post, so keep your chin tucked, let the held arm stay long, and slap with the free arm. Reaping deep is what makes the standing leg easy to find, which is why the deep hook wants a genuine off-balance in front of it.

viNotes.en: You will feel their leg arrive inside yours before anything else happens, and stepping out of the hook is a foot movement you can make on that touch alone. From there the counter is leg on leg with the chest square, so nothing needs to be seen. Keep both hands on the jacket: the backwards drive comes from them, not from the leg.
